gbm_population_evidence.quote: IDH1 Mutation; IDH2 Mutation; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent WHO Grade II Glioma; Recurrent WHO Grade III Glioma

gbm_population_flag.reason: Conditions and a 'GBM Arm' name glioblastoma, but every participant must have an IDH1/2-mutant tumour, which is not glioblastoma under WHO CNS5 (manual 1.1); the call decides S5.

candidate_evidence.quote: Determine the safety and tolerability of the combination of PARP inhibitor BGB-290 (BGB-290) and temozolomide (TMZ) in patients with recurrent IDH1/2 mutant glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Study of BGB-290 With Temozolomide in Recurrent Gliomas With IDH1/2 Mutations

role_evidence.quote: Determine the safety and tolerability of the combination of PARP inhibitor BGB-290 (BGB-290) and temozolomide (TMZ) in patients with recurrent IDH1/2 mutant glioma
Any DLT must be a toxicity considered at least possibly related to pamiparib (BGB-290) or TMZ.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: BGB-290 may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase I, dose de-escalation study of temozolomide followed by a phase II study.

flag.reason: IDH1/2 mutation is required for entry with a PARP inhibitor candidate, but the record states no mechanistic link between IDH mutation and BGB-290, so candidate_matched is coded false; this could change the primary biomarker outcome.

source_quote.quote: Patients must have documented molecular 1p/19q and MGMT testing.
Quantify 2-hydroxyglutarate (2HG) in archival formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) specimens via liquid chromatography mass spectrometry (LC-MS) detection and correlate with treatment response.
Assess tumor tissue BGB-290 levels, 2HG, and PolyADP-ribosylation (PARylation) in a patient subset treated with drug prior to re-resection.

coder_notes: All participants must have IDH1/2-mutant glioma (grade II-IV); the exploratory 'GBM Arm' is still IDH-mutant, so coded not_glioblastoma per the IDH-mutant-only rule. Temozolomide is in all arms with a de-escalated schedule explored in Phase I, coded established_therapy_experiment (not candidate); if instead treated as backbone the outcome for candidates is unchanged. MGMT row reflects a testing requirement only, not a status requirement.
